title: Uruguayan Pasta Bake
description: A hearty and flavorful pasta bake inspired by the rich culture of Uruguay. This dish combines the comforting taste of pasta with the bold flavors of Uruguayan cuisine.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked pasta, sautéed mushrooms, and shredded cheese. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with additional shredded cheese if desired.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
